subject: OrigoHealth onboarding — handoff, API seed & invite timetable
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lim <sara.lim@origohealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 07 Dec 2029 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: OrigoHealth onboarding — handoff, API seed & invite timetable

Hi Sara —

Welcome! Monica and I are kicking off the tenant activation and initial API seeding for OrigoHealth. Attached is a short checklist that outlines the sequence we usually run in the first two weeks. High level plan: 

- Day 0–1: Verify SSO domain + procurement window, exchange KMS preferences.
- Day 1–3: Create workspace + project namespaces, seed service account, deliver scoped API key for integration testing.
- Day 3–7: Admin invites (2 admins), role matrix validation, set up audit logging and retention baseline.
- Day 7–14: Test run with a sample workload, confirm latency/cost targets, post-signature ramp plan.

Questions for you before we lock dates:
1) Primary admin email(s) we should invite (we need 2 to start).
2) Do you have a preferred KMS (AWS KMS vs customer HSM) and region (e.g., us-east-1)?
3) Any procurement hold-ups (PO number or billing contact) we should be aware of so we don't hit roadblocks when seeding keys?

Proposed 30-min alignment call: Mon Dec 9, 10:00–10:30 PT — happy to adjust.

Attachment: origo-onboard-checklist.pdf (1 page) — includes minimal pre-reqs and roles matrix.

Thanks — looking forward.

— Diego Fernandez
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Sara Lim <sara.lim@origohealth.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: OrigoHealth IT <it@origohealth.com>
Date: Sat, 07 Dec 2029 11:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: OrigoHealth onboarding — handoff, API seed & invite timetable

Diego —

Thanks for the clear plan. Quick answers below:

- Admins: Sara Lim (sara.lim@origohealth.com) and Marcus Hsu (marcus.hsu@origohealth.com). Marcus is our platform lead.
- KMS: We prefer AWS KMS for this pilot, region us-east-1. We can discuss HSM later if needed.
- Procurement: PO is in flight, but billing contact is finance@origohealth.com — no blocking hold expected this week.

Two small asks from our side: 
1) Can you outline which IAM roles your seed script will create? We have strict least-privilege requirements and need to review before you create any service accounts.
2) For the API key provisioning: will you generate a short-lived key for our integration tests or a long-lived key to be rotated by us?

We can do the alignment call Monday at 10:00 PT. Putting IT on the thread for the IAM detail — Alejandro from IT will chime in if needed.

Best,
Sara
Head of Integrations, OrigoHealth

Subject: Re: OrigoHealth onboarding — handoff, API seed & invite timetable

Sara / team —

Thanks — quick technical note ahead of the call. Below is the minimal set of IAM roles and the seed approach we'll take. We'll only create the service account if you authorize the scoped role list during the call.

Planned service account roles (scoped):
- redwood-inference.serviceAgent: token-only, no console access.
- redwood-inference.readModelConfigs: read-only access to model catalog for routing.
- redwood-inference.writeUsageMetrics: aggregated metrics write to your logging endpoint (optional).

API key approach:
- For the initial integration test we will issue a time-limited API key (30 days) scoped to the test project namespace. That key is intended for staging only.
- After validation we'll hand off a rotation policy and a long-lived key pattern (90-day rotation) that you can manage via your preferred secrets manager.

Seed script and small helper: seed-script.sh attached (bash, idempotent). It will: create project namespace, seed a service account (if approved), upload minimal role bindings, and drop a test API key into a secure file for delivery.

Snippet of the seed flow (example):

# create namespace
# ./redwoodctl namespace create origo-staging --owner=sara.lim@origohealth.com
# seed service account (dry-run)

We also have a short runbook we'll link to in the call. If you want, we can pre-share the dry-run output before executing.

Attachment: seed-script.sh (shell script, ~120 lines)

— Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lim <sara.lim@origohealth.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 07 Dec 2029 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OrigoHealth onboarding — handoff, API seed & invite timetable

Perfect — thanks everyone.

Call confirmed: Mon Dec 9, 10:00–10:30 PT (calendar invite sent). Agenda: 1) Confirm admin invites, 2) Review IAM role list and dry-run output, 3) Approve KMS choice and delivery timeline, 4) Schedule Day-3 verification test.

Milestones and owners (initial):
- Workspace & namespace creation (Day 0–1): Diego + Ben (executes seed script)
- API key staging (Day 1–3): Ben creates short-lived key, Diego delivers to Sara and Marcus
- Admin invites & role verification (Day 1–4): Monica coordinates invites, Irene validates role bindings
- Audit logging baseline (Day 3–7): OrigoHealth IT + Diego verify delivery

I'll upload the runbook output to the shared Drive ahead of the call: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cOnboardDocs

If the PO clears before Monday and you want us to pre-run the dry-run, reply-all with approval and we’ll schedule a maintenance window (non-prod) to run the seed.

Thanks — speak Monday.

— Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
